blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The arrest of former House Speaker and presidential cousin Martin Romualdez is proof that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is keeping his promise to hold accountable those involved in the flood control mess, Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon said on Tuesday. Romualdez is in detention at the New Quezon City Jail for plunder in relation to his alleged collection if P7 billion in kickbacks from government projects from 2022 to 2025. “This is proof that the president and the Ombudsman’s vow last year to follow where the evidence leads, regardless of who is involved, even if it’s his relative, […]...
